messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
According to the robot cell sheet, which two areas must be identified for the safety of the operator working inside the Protected Space to operate the robot?

response.text: Secondo la scheda della cella robotizzata, quali due aree devono essere identificate per la sicurezza dell'operatore che lavora all'interno del Protected Space per far funzionare il robot?
